specification.objective: Isolate the remaining Flutter Web Kanban paint-offset defect inside the mounted KanbanBoardView by replacing the current material-heavy column/card subtree with a minimal real-data column probe. Keep the dedicated page, controller, shell, one-column no-scroll path, and board header unchanged while removing Card, clipping, inner Expanded, popup controls, chips, and card-tile rendering from the column surface so runtime behavior can determine whether the defect is triggered by that subtree.

requirements.statement: KanbanBoardView must remain mounted and must continue rendering real Kanban board data, including the loaded column name and card count.

The column surface must be reduced to a minimal static probe built from basic layout/text widgets and must not mount Card, PopupMenuButton, Chip, ActionChip, clipping configuration, or the previous static card-tile subtree.

The column probe must not render individual card number, card title, assignee controls, per-column rename/delete controls, or card management controls during this diagnostic slice; the board-level create-column header control remains unchanged.
The existing zero/one-column direct Row path and multi-column horizontal SingleChildScrollView path must remain unchanged so this increment isolates only the column subtree.

KanbanBoardView's public callback contract for structure, card, assignee, and movement actions must remain declared even though column/card action controls are intentionally unmounted in this diagnostic slice.
ProjectKanbanPage, WorkspaceScaffold, ProjectTasksController, renderer/bootstrap, Flutter SDK configuration, backend, API, persistence, authorization, and dependencies must remain unchanged.
The locked Change Contract must be versioned at docs/contracts/project-kanban-column-surface-probe-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The focused widget-test fixture still mounts KanbanBoardView and renders the real loaded column label 'A fazer (1)'.
KanbanBoardView source contains no Card construction, PopupMenuButton, Chip, ActionChip, clipBehavior, _StaticKanbanColumnPanel, or _StaticKanbanCardTile after the change.
The focused widget test asserts that the KanbanBoardView subtree contains no Card or PopupMenuButton and no longer renders '#1' or 'Implementar tela'.
The source retains the zero/one-column direct Row branch and the multi-column horizontal SingleChildScrollView branch.
All existing callback fields on KanbanBoardView remain declared while their material action controls are absent from the mounted column probe.
The payload changes only the Kanban board widget, its focused widget test, and the versioned locked contract.

invariants.statement: The prior placeholder experiment remains valid evidence that the dedicated page, shell, controller, and loaded Kanban data render correctly when the real board subtree is absent.
The prior single-column experiment established that the paint-offset defect persists without the horizontal SingleChildScrollView in the confirmed one-column reproduction.
The defect reproduces in both Chrome and Firefox, so this increment does not introduce browser-specific renderer workarounds.
Kanban persistence, authorization, optimistic concurrency, card identity, and ordering semantics remain untouched.

forbidden_states.statement: The diagnostic remounts any Card, PopupMenuButton, Chip, ActionChip, clipped column panel, or individual card tile inside KanbanBoardView.
The zero/one-column branch or multi-column scroll branch is altered beyond replacing the column-panel subtree.
Workspace shell, page/controller, web bootstrap, Flutter version/configuration, backend, API, persistence, authorization, or dependencies are modified.
The diagnostic removes KanbanBoardView entirely, which would repeat the already-completed whole-board isolation instead of narrowing the failing subtree.

inputs.statement: Baseline commit 0e85c1af127dde70558fe9d5248c1ec7ab849bdc, where the one-column direct Row path still reproduces the paint-offset defect.
The confirmed runtime board has one loaded column and the defect remains after removing list/reorder/drag primitives and the single-column horizontal scroll viewport.

outputs.statement: A mounted KanbanBoardView whose column area renders only real column name/card-count metadata through a minimal static probe.
A controlled runtime surface that can determine whether the former material column/card subtree is necessary for the paint-offset defect.

failure_semantics.statement: If the minimal real-data column probe is absent, any excluded material/card subtree remains, the previous single-column/multi-column layout paths are changed, or the focused regression expectation is missing, validation fails closed with project_kanban_column_surface_probe_missing.
Flutter/Dart tooling is unavailable in the artifact-production environment; widget-test source is updated but flutter test must not be represented as executed here.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; root=Path('.'); board=(root/'lib/features/projects/presentation/widgets/kanban_board.dart').read_text(); tests=(root/'test/features/projects/presentation/project_kanban_page_test.dart').read_text(); excluded=['return Card(','PopupMenuButton<','ActionChip(','Chip(','clipBehavior:','_StaticKanbanColumnPanel','_StaticKanbanCardTile']; callbacks=['onMoveCard','onReorderColumns','onCreateColumn','onRenameColumn','onDeleteColumn','onCreateCard','onEditCard','onDeleteCard','onManageAssignees']; ok=('if (board.columns.length <= 1)' in board and 'SingleChildScrollView(' in board and 'scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal' in board and "Text('${column.name} (${column.cards.length})')" in board and all(token not in board for token in excluded) and all(token in board for token in callbacks) and 'column surface probe strips material column subtree' in tests and 'matching: find.byType(Card)' in tests and 'matching: find.byType(PopupMenuButton)' in tests and "matching: find.text('#1')" in tests and "matching: find.text('Implementar tela')" in tests and tests.count('findsNothing') >= 4); print('project_kanban_column_surface_probe_ok' if ok else 'project_kanban_column_surface_probe_missing'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
